definitions.explanation: An electrically powered device with rotating blades that creates airflow to cool a room or provide ventilation.

examples.japanese: {扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
{扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: The breeze from the fan feels nice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: It was hot, so I turned on the fan.

examples.english: If you leave the fan on while sleeping, you might feel sluggish when you wake up in the morning.

notes:
{扇風機|せんぷうき} is the standard word for an electric fan. The word combines {扇|せん} (fan) + {風|ふう} (wind) + {機|き} (machine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧/⟦かける→かける：noentry⟧: to turn on a fan
- {扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧/⟦とめる→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to turn off a fan
- {扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: the breeze from a fan
- ⟦{首振|くびふ}り→首振り：noentry⟧{扇風機|せんぷうき}: oscillating fan

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner (cools more effectively)
- ⟦{換気扇|かんきせん}→換気扇：04678_kankisen⟧: ventilation/exhaust fan (used in kitchens and bathrooms)
- ⟦{団扇|うちわ}→団扇：04544_uchiwa⟧: flat hand fan (traditional)
- ⟦{扇子|せんす}→扇子：04039_sensu⟧: folding fan

CULTURAL NOTE:
There is a well-known urban legend in Japan about "fan death" ({扇風機|せんぷうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都市伝説|としでんせつ}→都市伝説：28748_toshidensetsu⟧), though it is more associated with Korea. Many Japanese people avoid sleeping with a fan blowing directly on them.
